hooks.command: $raw = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); try { $d = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop; $t = $d.tool_input.subagent_type; if ($t -in @('tech-lead-frontend','tech-lead-backend')) { $cur = (git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>&1).Trim(); if ($cur -eq 'develop') { $p = if ($t -eq 'tech-lead-frontend') {'frontend'} else {'backend'}; $b = 'feature/' + $p + '-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmm'); git checkout -b $b 2>&1 | Out-Null; @{ hookSpecificOutput = @{ hookEventName = 'PreToolUse'; additionalContext = '[GOVERNANCE] Branche ' + $b + ' creee automatiquement. Le dev agent travaille sur cette branche. Le code-reviewer commitera, poussera et mergera vers develop apres validation.' } } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress } } } catch {}
cd $(pwd) && git diff --quiet || echo '📝 Files modified'

$raw = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); try { $d = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop; $t = $d.tool_input.subagent_type; if ($t -in @('tech-lead-frontend','tech-lead-backend')) { $br = (git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>&1).Trim(); $msg = '[GOVERNANCE] ' + $t + ' a termine ses modifications sur la branche ' + $br + '. WORKFLOW OBLIGATOIRE : 1) Lance le code-reviewer (Agent tool, subagent_type: code-reviewer) 2) Si APPROUVE : git add > commit > push ' + $br + ' > merge --no-ff vers develop > push develop 3) Si REJETE : git add > commit [WIP] > push ' + $br + ' > NE PAS merger develop.'; Write-Output $msg; exit 2 } } catch {}
